+"""TP/SP correctness for Engram.
+
+Runs under the CI unit-test launcher (torch.distributed.run at 8 ranks) as well as local
+torchrun with 2 or 4 ranks: each case treats the first ``tp_size`` ranks as one
+tensor-parallel group with sequence parallelism enabled (EP=1, expert-DP=1). Each rank
+forwards its contiguous sequence slice; outputs must match the full-sequence reference
+(including the convolution halo across the slice boundary), and gradients of the replicated
+Engram parameters must match after the TP sum that
+``_allreduce_non_tensor_model_parallel_grads`` performs during gradient finalization.
+"""
+
+import os
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+
+import pytest
+import torch
+
+from megatron.core.distributed.finalize_model_grads import (
+    _allreduce_non_tensor_model_parallel_grads,
+)
+from megatron.core.models.engram.config import EngramConfig
+from megatron.core.models.engram.engram import Engram
+from tests.unit_tests.test_utilities import Utils
+
+from ._test_utils import make_module_config, make_pg_collection, write_tokenizer_map
+
+pytestmark = pytest.mark.skipif(
+    int(os.environ.get("WORLD_SIZE", "1")) not in (2, 4, 8),
+    reason="requires torchrun with two, four, or eight ranks",
+)
+
+# Must be at least (kernel_size - 1) * max_ngram_order = 9 so the SP convolution halo is
+# a single-hop exchange; the runtime guard in Engram enforces the same bound.
+_SEQUENCE_PER_RANK = 12
+_BATCH_SIZE = 2
+_HIDDEN_SIZE = 8
+
+
+def _build_module(tmp_path, tp_group, sequence_parallel):
+    artifact = tmp_path / "map.json"
+    if not artifact.exists():
+        write_tokenizer_map(artifact, vocab_size=32, layer_ids=(1,))
+    engram_config = EngramConfig(
+        global_vocab_sizes=(17, 19),
+        layer_ids=(1,),
+        max_ngram_order=3,
+        num_hash_heads=2,
+        memory_dim=8,
+        kernel_size=4,
+        hash_seed=0,
+        boundary_token_id=0,
+        tokenizer_map_path=str(artifact),
+    )
+    torch.manual_seed(2026)
+    module = Engram(
+        config=make_module_config(sequence_parallel=sequence_parallel),
+        engram_config=engram_config,
+        layer_number=1,
+        pg_collection=make_pg_collection(tp=tp_group),
+    )
+    with torch.no_grad():
+        # A nonzero convolution branch so the halo exchange and its gradients matter.
+        module.short_conv.weight.normal_(mean=0.0, std=0.05)
+    return module.to(torch.cuda.current_device())
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("tp_size", [2, 4])
+def test_sp_sliced_gradients_match_full_sequence_reference(tmp_path_factory, tp_size):
+    Utils.initialize_distributed()
+    rank = torch.distributed.get_rank()
+    world_size = torch.distributed.get_world_size()
+    if world_size < tp_size:
+        pytest.skip(f"requires at least {tp_size} ranks")
+    # Collective on the default group: every rank must participate in group creation.
+    tp_group = torch.distributed.new_group(ranks=list(range(tp_size)))
+    if rank >= tp_size:
+        return
+    device = torch.device("cuda", torch.cuda.current_device())
+    tmp_path = tmp_path_factory.getbasetemp()
+
+    sp_module = _build_module(tmp_path, tp_group, sequence_parallel=True)
+    reference_module = _build_module(tmp_path, tp_group, sequence_parallel=False)
+    for sp_param, ref_param in zip(sp_module.parameters(), reference_module.parameters()):
+        torch.testing.assert_close(sp_param, ref_param)
+
+    # The constructors route the sparse tables to the dedicated Engram reduction path
+    # (expert DDP bucket via allreduce=False) and mark every parameter for the SP TP-sum.
+    for name, parameter in sp_module.named_parameters():
+        assert getattr(parameter, "sequence_parallel", False), name
+        if getattr(parameter, "is_engram_embedding", False):
+            assert parameter.allreduce is False, name
+        else:
+            assert getattr(parameter, "allreduce", True), name
+
+    full_sequence = _SEQUENCE_PER_RANK * tp_size
+    generator = torch.Generator(device="cpu").manual_seed(11)
+    tokens = torch.randint(
+        0, 32, (_BATCH_SIZE, full_sequence), generator=generator, dtype=torch.int64
+    ).to(device)
+    hidden_full = torch.randn(
+        full_sequence, _BATCH_SIZE, _HIDDEN_SIZE, generator=generator, dtype=torch.float64
+    ).to(device)
+    projection = torch.randn(
+        full_sequence, _BATCH_SIZE, _HIDDEN_SIZE, generator=generator, dtype=torch.float64
+    ).to(device)
+
+    sequence_slice = slice(rank * _SEQUENCE_PER_RANK, (rank + 1) * _SEQUENCE_PER_RANK)
+    local_output = sp_module(hidden_full[sequence_slice], tokens)
+    reference_output = reference_module(hidden_full, tokens)
+    # Covers the convolution halo: positions near the slice start depend on the previous
+    # rank's values, which only the halo exchange can provide.
+    torch.testing.assert_close(local_output, reference_output[sequence_slice])
+
+    (local_output * projection[sequence_slice]).sum().backward()
+    (reference_output * projection).sum().backward()
+
+    # Gradient finalization: the TP sum for sequence-parallel parameters, including the
+    # dedicated unflattened path for the sparse tables.
+    model_chunk = sp_module
+    model_chunk.ddp_config = SimpleNamespace(use_megatron_fsdp=False)
+    finalize_config = SimpleNamespace(sequence_parallel=True, qk_layernorm=False)
+    _allreduce_non_tensor_model_parallel_grads([model_chunk], finalize_config, tp_group)
+
+    for (name, sp_param), ref_param in zip(
+        sp_module.named_parameters(), reference_module.parameters()
+    ):
+        assert sp_param.grad is not None, name
+        torch.testing.assert_close(sp_param.grad, ref_param.grad, msg=name)

+"""Virtual pipeline parallelism: one token prefetch feeding every model chunk.
+
+Under VPP the scheduler gives each model chunk its own data iterator and indexes that list
+itself before calling ``forward_step``, so each chunk ends up holding its own wrapper. Tokens
+depend only on the microbatch, never on the chunk, so a single prefetch has to serve all of
+them -- each with an independent cursor, because the interleaved schedule consumes chunks out
+of lockstep.
+"""
+
+import pytest
+import torch
+
+from megatron.training.utils import get_pipeline_prefetched_tokens, prepare_tokens_for_pipeline
+
+
+@pytest.fixture
+def single_rank(monkeypatch):
+    """Collapse PP and TP so the helper takes its no-collective path."""
+    monkeypatch.setattr("megatron.training.utils.common_utils.get_pg_size", lambda _: 1)
+    monkeypatch.setattr("megatron.training.utils.common_utils.get_pg_rank", lambda _: 0)
+
+
+@pytest.fixture
+def two_rank(monkeypatch):
+    """Two peers so the helper takes the prefetch-and-broadcast path, with comms stubbed."""
+    monkeypatch.setattr("megatron.training.utils.common_utils.get_pg_size", lambda _: 2)
+    monkeypatch.setattr("megatron.training.utils.common_utils.get_pg_rank", lambda _: 0)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(torch.distributed, "broadcast", lambda *a, **k: None)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(torch.distributed, "get_global_rank", lambda group, rank: rank)
+
+
+def _batches(count, seq=4, mbs=1):
+    return [
+        {"tokens": torch.arange(i * seq * mbs, (i + 1) * seq * mbs).view(mbs, seq), "id": i}
+        for i in range(count)
+    ]
+
+
+def test_a_list_of_iterators_yields_one_wrapper_per_chunk(two_rank):
+    chunks = [iter(_batches(2)), iter(_batches(2)), iter(_batches(2))]
+    wrappers = prepare_tokens_for_pipeline(chunks, 2, 1, 4, object(), object())
+
+    assert isinstance(wrappers, list) and len(wrappers) == 3
+    # Each chunk owns an independent cursor over the same tokens.
+    assert wrappers[0] is not wrappers[1]
+
+
+def test_every_chunk_sees_the_same_tokens_for_the_same_microbatch(two_rank):
+    expected = _batches(3)
+    chunks = [iter(_batches(3)) for _ in range(2)]
+    wrappers = prepare_tokens_for_pipeline(chunks, 3, 1, 4, object(), object())
+
+    for microbatch in range(3):
+        per_chunk = []
+        for wrapper in wrappers:
+            next(wrapper)
+            per_chunk.append(get_pipeline_prefetched_tokens(wrapper))
+        torch.testing.assert_close(
+            per_chunk[0], expected[microbatch]["tokens"].to(per_chunk[0].device)
+        )
+        # Chunk 1 must see byte-identical tokens for the same microbatch.
+        torch.testing.assert_close(per_chunk[1], per_chunk[0])
+
+
+def test_chunks_may_be_consumed_out_of_lockstep(two_rank):
+    """The interleaved schedule runs chunk 0 ahead of chunk 1; cursors must not interfere."""
+    expected = _batches(3)
+    chunks = [iter(_batches(3)) for _ in range(2)]
+    first, second = prepare_tokens_for_pipeline(chunks, 3, 1, 4, object(), object())
+
+    # Chunk 0 runs all three microbatches before chunk 1 runs any.
+    seen_first = []
+    for _ in range(3):
+        next(first)
+        seen_first.append(get_pipeline_prefetched_tokens(first))
+    seen_second = []
+    for _ in range(3):
+        next(second)
+        seen_second.append(get_pipeline_prefetched_tokens(second))
+
+    for microbatch in range(3):
+        torch.testing.assert_close(
+            seen_first[microbatch], expected[microbatch]["tokens"].to(seen_first[0].device)
+        )
+        torch.testing.assert_close(seen_second[microbatch], seen_first[microbatch])
+
+
+def test_each_chunk_keeps_its_own_exhaustion_guard(two_rank):
+    chunks = [iter(_batches(1)), iter(_batches(1))]

+"""Muon with the precision-aware optimizer.
+
+The precision-aware flag applies to the scalar Adam next to Muon; with
+``muon_store_param_remainders`` Muon also keeps BF16 params with int16 remainders instead of
+FP32 main params. Sections, in order:
+
+- The remainder encoding: split / merge round-trips every FP32 bit pattern, and the fused
+  update kernel matches the FP32 ``add_`` ops it replaces bit for bit.
+- Config guards for ``muon_store_param_remainders`` and the precision-aware optimizer
+  under Muon.
+- End to end through ``get_megatron_optimizer``: layer-sharded Muon, with or without
+  remainders, keeps the same FP32 main params as without the precision-aware optimizer, step
+  after step, while the scalar Adam params go through a precision-aware DistributedOptimizer.
+
+Launch: torchrun --nproc-per-node=<n> -m pytest
+    tests/unit_tests/optimizer/test_muon_precision_aware_optimizer.py
+"""
+
+import pytest
+import torch
+import torch.nn as nn
+
+from megatron.core.optimizer.param_remainders import (
+    apply_update_with_remainder,
+    merge_main_param,
+    split_main_param,
+)
+
+_DEVICES = ["cpu"] + (["cuda"] if torch.cuda.is_available() else [])
+
+
+def _fp32_samples(device, n=1 << 16):
+    """Random FP32 values over many magnitudes plus every low-half pattern at ties and
+    signed zeros, infinities and subnormals."""
+    torch.manual_seed(0)
+    values = torch.randn(n, device=device) * torch.logspace(-30, 30, n, device=device)
+    ties = (torch.randint(0, 1 << 15, (1024,), device=device, dtype=torch.int32) << 16) | 0x8000
+    specials = torch.tensor(
+        [0.0, -0.0, float("inf"), float("-inf"), 1e-40, -1e-40, 3.4e38, -3.4e38], device=device
+    )
+    return torch.cat([values, ties.view(torch.float32), -ties.view(torch.float32), specials])
+
+
+def _split(main):
+    param = torch.empty_like(main, dtype=torch.bfloat16)
+    remainder = torch.empty_like(main, dtype=torch.int16)
+    split_main_param(main, param, remainder)
+    return param, remainder
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("device", _DEVICES)
+def test_split_merge_round_trips_every_bit(device):
+    main = _fp32_samples(device)
+    param, remainder = _split(main)
+    assert torch.equal(merge_main_param(param, remainder).view(torch.int32), main.view(torch.int32))
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("device", _DEVICES)
+def test_bf16_half_matches_round_to_nearest_off_ties(device):
+    """The BF16 half is the FP32 value rounded half away from zero: the same as PyTorch's
+    round-to-nearest-even cast except on exact ties, where it may be one ulp further out."""
+    main = _fp32_samples(device)
+    param, _ = _split(main)
+    finite = torch.isfinite(main) & torch.isfinite(main.bfloat16().float())
+    tie = (main.view(torch.int32) & 0xFFFF) == 0x8000
+    off_tie = finite & ~tie
+    assert torch.equal(param[off_tie].float(), main.bfloat16()[off_tie].float())
+    finite_tie = finite & tie
+    assert bool((param[finite_tie].float().abs() > main[finite_tie].abs()).all())
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("device", _DEVICES)
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("weight_decay_alpha", [None, -1e-3], ids=["no_wd", "wd"])
+def test_fused_update_matches_fp32_add_ops(device, weight_decay_alpha):
+    torch.manual_seed(1)
+    main = torch.randn(3, 4099, device=device)  # not a multiple of the kernel block
+    update = torch.randn(3, 4099, device=device)
+    update_alpha = -3e-4
+
+    reference = main.clone()
+    if weight_decay_alpha is not None:
+        reference.add_(reference, alpha=weight_decay_alpha)
+    reference.add_(update, alpha=update_alpha)
+
+    param, remainder = _split(main)
+    apply_update_with_remainder(
+        param, remainder, update, update_alpha=update_alpha, weight_decay_alpha=weight_decay_alpha
+    )
+    merged = merge_main_param(param, remainder)
+    assert torch.equal(
+        merged.view(torch.int32), reference.view(torch.int32)
+    ), f"max |diff| {(merged - reference).abs().max().item():.3e}"
+
+
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+# Config guards
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+_MUON_CONFIG = dict(
+    optimizer='muon',
+    bf16=True,
+    use_layer_wise_distributed_optimizer=True,
+    muon_tp_mode='layer_sharded',
+    muon_split_qkv=False,
+)
+
+
+def _config(**kwargs):
+    pytest.importorskip("transformer_engine", reason="precision-aware optimizer needs TE")
+    from megatron.core.optimizer import OptimizerConfig
+
+    return OptimizerConfig(**{**_MUON_CONFIG, **kwargs})
+
+
+def test_precision_aware_optimizer_accepted_with_muon():
+    config = _config(use_precision_aware_optimizer=True, exp_avg_dtype=torch.bfloat16)
+    plain = config.without_precision_aware_optimizer()
+    assert not plain.use_precision_aware_optimizer
+    assert not plain.use_precision_aware_optimizer_no_fp8_or_ds_fp8
+    assert plain.exp_avg_dtype == torch.float32
+    assert config.use_precision_aware_optimizer, "the copy must not touch the original"
+
+
+def test_precision_aware_optimizer_rejected_with_lion_scalar_optimizer():

+        _config(use_precision_aware_optimizer=True, muon_scalar_optimizer='lion')
+
+
+def test_optimizer_cuda_graph_keeps_full_fp32_adam_master_params():

+    assert _config(use_precision_aware_optimizer=True).store_param_remainders
+    config = _config(use_precision_aware_optimizer=True, optimizer_cuda_graph=True)
+    assert not config.store_param_remainders

+def test_param_remainders_need_precision_aware_optimizer():

+        _config(muon_store_param_remainders=True)
+
+
+def test_param_remainders_need_layer_sharded_muon():
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="layer_sharded"):

+            use_precision_aware_optimizer=True,

+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+# End to end
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+
+class _Model(nn.Module):
+    """Five matrices for Muon (two of one shape, for batched NS) plus biases for Adam. ``fc4``
+    is kept in FP32 (as e.g. routers are), so Muon also steps an FP32 param."""
+
+    def __init__(self):
+        super().__init__()
+        self.fc1 = nn.Linear(80, 48)
+        self.fc2 = nn.Linear(48, 48)
+        self.fc3 = nn.Linear(48, 48)
+        self.fc4 = nn.Linear(48, 24)
+        self.fc5 = nn.Linear(24, 10)
+
+
+@pytest.fixture
+def _model_parallel():
+    from tests.unit_tests.test_utilities import Utils
+
+    Utils.initialize_model_parallel()
+    yield
+    Utils.destroy_model_parallel()
+
+
+def _build(precision_aware, remainders, ns_batch_size, copy_from=None):
+    from megatron.core import parallel_state
+    from megatron.core.distributed import DistributedDataParallelConfig
+    from megatron.core.optimizer import OptimizerConfig, get_megatron_optimizer
+    from megatron.core.process_groups_config import ProcessGroupCollection
+    from megatron.core.transformer import TransformerConfig
+    from megatron.training.training import wrap_model_chunks_with_ddp
+
+    model = _Model().bfloat16().cuda()
+    model.fc4.float()
+    model = wrap_model_chunks_with_ddp(
+        [model],
+        TransformerConfig(num_attention_heads=1, num_layers=1),
+        DistributedDataParallelConfig(),
+        use_layer_wise_distributed_optimizer=True,
+    )[0]
+    if copy_from is None:
+        model.broadcast_params()
+    else:
+        model.module.load_state_dict(copy_from.module.state_dict())
+
+    config = OptimizerConfig(
+        **_MUON_CONFIG,
+        lr=1e-2,
+        weight_decay=0.1,
+        clip_grad=1.0,
+        use_distributed_optimizer=False,
+        muon_ns_batch_size=ns_batch_size,
+        use_precision_aware_optimizer=precision_aware,
+        muon_store_param_remainders=remainders,
+    )
+    pg_collection = ProcessGroupCollection.use_mpu_process_groups()
+    pg_collection.dp_cp = parallel_state.get_data_parallel_group(with_context_parallel=True)
+    pg_collection.expt_dp = parallel_state.get_expert_data_parallel_group()
+    optimizer = get_megatron_optimizer(
+        config, [model], pg_collection=pg_collection, use_gloo_process_groups=False
+    )
+    return model, optimizer
+
+
+def _muon_wrappers(optimizer):
+    """The Float16 wrappers inside the LayerWise optimizer (first child of the chain)."""
+    from megatron.core.optimizer.layer_wise_optimizer import LayerWiseDistributedOptimizer
+
+    layer_wise = optimizer.chained_optimizers[0]
+    assert isinstance(layer_wise, LayerWiseDistributedOptimizer)
+    return layer_wise.chained_optimizers
+
+
+def _main_params(optimizer):
+    """id(model param) -> FP32 main value of every Muon param this rank updates."""
+    from megatron.core.optimizer.param_remainders import Float16OptimizerWithParamRemainders
+
+    mains = {}
+    for wrapper in _muon_wrappers(optimizer):
+        if isinstance(wrapper, Float16OptimizerWithParamRemainders):
+            for params, remainders in zip(wrapper.float16_groups, wrapper.remainder_groups):
+                for param, remainder in zip(params, remainders):
+                    mains[id(param)] = merge_main_param(param, remainder)
+        else:
+            for params, main_group in zip(wrapper.float16_groups, wrapper.fp32_from_float16_groups):
+                for param, main_param in zip(params, main_group):
+                    mains[id(param)] = main_param.detach().clone()
+        for group in wrapper.fp32_from_fp32_groups:
+            for param in group:
+                mains[id(param)] = param.detach().clone()
+    return mains
+
+
+@pytest.mark.skipif(not torch.cuda.is_available(), reason="requires CUDA")
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("remainders", [False, True], ids=["fp32_main", "remainders"])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("ns_batch_size", [1, 2], ids=["ns_batch1", "ns_batch2"])
+def test_muon_keeps_fp32_main_params_bitwise(_model_parallel, ns_batch_size, remainders):
+    pytest.importorskip("emerging_optimizers", reason="LayerShardedMuon needs emerging-optimizers")
+    pytest.importorskip("transformer_engine", reason="precision-aware optimizer needs TE")
+    from megatron.core.optimizer.param_remainders import Float16OptimizerWithParamRemainders
+
+    reference_model, reference = _build(False, False, ns_batch_size)
+    model, optimizer = _build(True, remainders, ns_batch_size, copy_from=reference_model)
+    assert all(
+        isinstance(w, Float16OptimizerWithParamRemainders) == remainders
+        for w in _muon_wrappers(optimizer)
+    )
+    # The scalar Adam is precision-aware, Muon's side is not unless it stores remainders.
+    assert optimizer.chained_optimizers[1].config.use_precision_aware_optimizer
+    assert _muon_wrappers(optimizer)[0].config.use_precision_aware_optimizer == remainders
+
+    names = [name for name, _ in model.module.named_parameters()]
+    params = dict(model.module.named_parameters())
+    reference_params = dict(reference_model.module.named_parameters())
+    torch.manual_seed(2)
+    for step in range(3):
+        for name in names:
+            grad = torch.randn_like(params[name], dtype=torch.float32)
+            torch.distributed.broadcast(grad, src=0)
+            params[name].main_grad = grad.clone()
+            reference_params[name].main_grad = grad.clone()
+
+        _, grad_norm, _ = optimizer.step()
+        _, reference_grad_norm, _ = reference.step()
+        assert float(grad_norm) == pytest.approx(float(reference_grad_norm), rel=1e-6)
+
+        mains, reference_mains = _main_params(optimizer), _main_params(reference)
+        by_name = {id(params[n]): n for n in names}
+        reference_by_name = {n: id(reference_params[n]) for n in names}
+        assert mains, "this rank owns no Muon params"
+        for param_id, main in mains.items():
+            name = by_name[param_id]
+            reference_main = reference_mains[reference_by_name[name]]
+            assert torch.equal(
+                main.view(torch.int32), reference_main.view(torch.int32)
+            ), f"step {step} {name}: max |diff| {(main - reference_main).abs().max().item():.3e}"
+
+        # Every rank sees every updated BF16 param after the param sync; Muon's equal the
+        # reference off ties, the precision-aware Adam biases stay close.
+        for name in names:
+            torch.testing.assert_close(
+                params[name].float(), reference_params[name].float(), atol=1e-2, rtol=1e-2
+            )
+
+
+@pytest.mark.skipif(not torch.cuda.is_available(), reason="requires CUDA")
+def test_remainder_checkpoint_carries_fp32_main_params(_model_parallel):
+    pytest.importorskip("emerging_optimizers", reason="LayerShardedMuon needs emerging-optimizers")
+    pytest.importorskip("transformer_engine", reason="precision-aware optimizer needs TE")

+        ):

+                assert torch.equal(merge_main_param(param, remainder), main)

+def _cu_seqlens(lengths):
+    assert sum(lengths) == TOKENS and len(lengths) <= MAX_SEQS
+    cu = [0]
+    for length in lengths:
+        cu.append(cu[-1] + length)
+    cu += [TOKENS] * (MAX_SEQS + 1 - len(cu))

+class _PackedForward(torch.nn.Module):
+    """Graph callable: the wrapper forward on a THD pack with a static boundary buffer."""
+
+    def __init__(self, wrapper):
+        super().__init__()
+        self.wrapper = wrapper
+
+    def forward(self, hidden_states, cu_seqlens):
+        # Mirrors the wrapper's capture-path reconstruction: static max_seqlen and
+        # pad_between_seqs, no host reads of the boundaries.
+        params = PackedSeqParams(
+            qkv_format="thd",
+            cu_seqlens_q=cu_seqlens,
+            cu_seqlens_kv=cu_seqlens,
+            cu_seqlens_q_padded=cu_seqlens,
+            cu_seqlens_kv_padded=cu_seqlens,
+            max_seqlen_q=TOKENS,
+            max_seqlen_kv=TOKENS,
+            pad_between_seqs=True,
+        )
+        out, _ = self.wrapper(hidden_states, packed_seq_params=params)
+        return out
+
+
+def _run(fn, wrapper, x, cu, grad_out):
+    wrapper.zero_grad(set_to_none=True)
+    x = x.detach().clone().requires_grad_(True)
+    out = fn(x, cu)
+    out.backward(grad_out)
+    grads = {name: p.grad.detach().clone() for name, p in wrapper.named_parameters()}
+    return out.detach().clone(), x.grad.detach().clone(), grads

+"""Tests for the fixed-shape ``chunk_indices`` table used for THD CUDA graph capture.
+
+The table is what makes fla's varlen kernels capturable: only its *shape* is a
+capture-time constant, its values are recomputed on every replay. It must agree
+element-for-element with fla's own host-built table, and it must preserve fla's
+``row == chunk_offsets[seq] + intra`` invariant, which the ``h``/``dh`` reader
+kernels rely on to index into the chunk-state buffer.
+"""

+import copy
+
+import pytest
+import torch
+
+import megatron.core.ssm.gated_delta_net.common as common
+from megatron.core.ssm.gated_delta_net.common import _FLA_CHUNK_SIZE, _GDNBase
+from megatron.core.transformer.enums import CudaGraphModule

+try:
+    from fla.ops.utils.index import prepare_chunk_indices, prepare_chunk_offsets
+
+    HAVE_FLA = True
+except ImportError:
+    HAVE_FLA = False
+
+
+class _Config:
+    thd_max_packed_sequences = 8
+    max_seqlen_per_dp_cp_rank = 4096
+    context_parallel_size = 1
+
+
+class _Stub:
+    """Minimal stand-in exposing just the pure table builder off ``_GDNBase``."""
+
+    _fixed_shape_chunk_indices = _GDNBase._fixed_shape_chunk_indices
+    _chunk_slot_arange = _GDNBase._chunk_slot_arange
+
+    def __init__(self):
+        self.config = _Config()
+        self._chunk_slot_cache = {}
+
+
+def _make_cu_seqlens(lens, extra_tokens=0):
+    """Build a statically-shaped cu_seqlens, padded with zero-length sequences."""
+    cu = [0]
+    for length in lens:
+        cu.append(cu[-1] + length)
+    cu[-1] += extra_tokens
+    while len(cu) < _Config.thd_max_packed_sequences + 1:
+        cu.append(cu[-1])
+    return torch.tensor(cu, device="cuda", dtype=torch.int32)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.skipif(not HAVE_FLA, reason="fla is not installed")
+@pytest.mark.skipif(not torch.cuda.is_available(), reason="CUDA is required")
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "lens",
+    [
+        [4096],
+        [2048, 2048],
+        [1024, 512, 1536, 1024],
+        [64, 64, 3968],
+        [100, 200, 300, 3496],  # every sequence ends mid-chunk
+        [512] * 8,  # cu_seqlens fully occupied, no padding sequences
+        [_FLA_CHUNK_SIZE * 7 + 1] * 8,  # worst case for the NT_max bound
+    ],
+)
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("extra_tokens", [0, 16, 63, 127])
+def test_matches_fla_prepare_chunk_indices(lens, extra_tokens):
+    stub = _Stub()
+    cu_seqlens = _make_cu_seqlens(lens, extra_tokens=extra_tokens)
+
+    table = stub._fixed_shape_chunk_indices(cu_seqlens, extra_tokens=extra_tokens)
+    reference = prepare_chunk_indices(cu_seqlens, _FLA_CHUNK_SIZE)
+    num_real = reference.shape[0]
+
+    # The shape is a fixed upper bound; under-sizing it would silently drop chunks,
+    # since NT is the Triton grid dimension.
+    assert table.shape[0] >= num_real
+    assert table.dtype == cu_seqlens.dtype
+    # Real rows are bit-identical to fla's own table, and stay contiguous from row 0.
+    assert torch.equal(table[:num_real], reference)
+
+    # fla's h/dh reader kernels index by row, the writer by chunk_offsets[seq] + intra.
+    chunk_offsets = prepare_chunk_offsets(cu_seqlens, _FLA_CHUNK_SIZE)
+    rows = torch.arange(num_real, device=cu_seqlens.device, dtype=torch.int64)
+    assert torch.equal(chunk_offsets[table[:num_real, 0].long()] + table[:num_real, 1], rows)
+
+    # Trailing pad rows point at sequence 0 with an out-of-range intra index, so every
+    # masked load/store in fla's kernels (all gated on o_t < T) no-ops.
+    assert torch.all(table[num_real:, 0] == 0)
+    assert torch.all(table[num_real:, 1] >= table.shape[0])

+    def test_cute_forward_runs_and_matches_fla(self, monkeypatch, caplog):
+        fla_layer = self._layer("fla")
+        cute_layer = self._layer("internal")
+        cute_layer.load_state_dict(fla_layer.state_dict())
+        torch.manual_seed(0)
+        x = torch.randn(2048, 1, 1024, device="cuda", dtype=torch.bfloat16)
+
+        def run(layer):
+            h = x.clone().requires_grad_(True)
+            out, _ = layer(h, None)
+            out.float().square().mean().backward()
+            return out.detach(), h.grad
+
+        ref_out, ref_grad = run(fla_layer)
+        # "cute" raises instead of falling back, so passing proves the CuTe DSL forward ran.
+        # H = 48 value heads: the fused CuTe backward serves H = 64 only, so the backward of
+        # this geometry is fla's under "auto"; check the forward under "cute" on its own.
+        monkeypatch.setenv("MCORE_GDN_INTERNAL_BACKEND", "cute")
+        with torch.no_grad():

+        from megatron.core.ssm.gated_delta_net.internal_gdn_backend import implementation
+
+        monkeypatch.setattr(implementation, "_reported_paths", set())
+        monkeypatch.setenv("MCORE_GDN_INTERNAL_BACKEND", "auto")
+        with caplog.at_level(logging.INFO):
+            out, grad = run(cute_layer)
+        paths = " | ".join(r.getMessage() for r in caplog.records)
+        print(f"GDN_INTERNAL_PATHS {paths}")
+        assert "Internal GDN backend forward: CuTe DSL" in paths
+        for name, a, b in (
+            ("fwd_cute", cute_fwd, ref_out),
+            ("out", out, ref_out),
+            ("dx", grad, ref_grad),
+        ):
+            err = ((a.float() - b.float()).norm() / b.float().norm()).item()
+            print(f"GDN_INTERNAL_VS_FLA {name}={err:.3e}")
+            assert err < 2e-2, f"{name}: internal vs fla rel-L2 {err:.3e}"

+def _build_gdn(cp_group, **config_overrides):
+    """Build a GDN wired to ``cp_group`` (chunkwise CP when its size is > 1)."""
+    config = TransformerConfig(
+        **_gdn_config_kwargs(context_parallel_size=cp_group.size(), **config_overrides)
+    )
+    pg_collection = ProcessGroupCollection(
+        tp=parallel_state.get_tensor_model_parallel_group(), cp=cp_group
+    )
+    gdn = GatedDeltaNet(
+        config,
+        submodules=get_experimental_attention_variant_module_spec(config=config).submodules,
+        layer_number=1,
+        bias=False,
+        conv_bias=False,
+        conv_init=1.0,
+        use_qk_l2norm=True,
+        A_init_range=(1, 16),
+        pg_collection=pg_collection,
+    )
+    return gdn.cuda().bfloat16()
+
+
+def _make_packed_seq_params(seq_lens):
+    cu = torch.tensor(
+        [0] + torch.cumsum(torch.tensor(seq_lens), 0).tolist(),
+        dtype=torch.int32,
+        device=torch.cuda.current_device(),
+    )
+    total = int(cu[-1].item())
+    return PackedSeqParams(
+        qkv_format="thd",
+        cu_seqlens_q=cu,
+        cu_seqlens_kv=cu,
+        max_seqlen_q=max(seq_lens),
+        max_seqlen_kv=max(seq_lens),
+        total_tokens=total,
+    )
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "seq_lens,fusion",
+    (
+        pytest.param(None, False, id="sbhd"),
+        pytest.param([96, 32], False, id="thd"),
+        pytest.param([4, 60], False, id="thd-short-boundary"),
+        pytest.param(None, True, id="sbhd-fused-pre-gdr"),
+        pytest.param([96, 32], True, id="thd-fused-pre-gdr"),
+    ),
+)
+class TestGatedDeltaNetChunkwiseCP:
+    """GDN with chunkwise CP=2 matches a CP=1 reference on the full sequence."""
+
+    pytestmark = _requires_cp2
+
+    @pytest.fixture(autouse=True)
+    def setup_method(self):
+        Utils.initialize_model_parallel(
+            tensor_model_parallel_size=1, pipeline_model_parallel_size=1, context_parallel_size=2
+        )
+        model_parallel_cuda_manual_seed(123)
+        yield
+        torch.cuda.synchronize()
+        Utils.destroy_model_parallel()
+
+    def test_forward_and_backward_match_reference(self, seq_lens, fusion):
+        if fusion and not HAVE_FUSED_PRE_GDR:
+            pytest.skip("causal-conv1d fused backward is not installed.")
+        cp_group = parallel_state.get_context_parallel_group()
+        cp_rank = parallel_state.get_context_parallel_rank()
+        world_size = torch.distributed.get_world_size()
+        global_rank = torch.distributed.get_rank()
+        cp1_group = [torch.distributed.new_group(ranks=[r]) for r in range(world_size)][global_rank]
+
+        gdn_cp = _build_gdn(cp_group, gdn_pre_gated_delta_rule_fusion=fusion)
+        for parameter in gdn_cp.parameters():
+            torch.distributed.broadcast(parameter.data, src=0)
+        gdn_reference = _build_gdn(cp1_group, linear_cp_mode="headwise", linear_cp_layout="zigzag")
+        gdn_reference.load_state_dict(gdn_cp.state_dict())
+
+        packed_seq_params = None
+        if seq_lens is None:
+            total_tokens = 128
+        else:
+            packed_seq_params = _make_packed_seq_params(seq_lens)
+            total_tokens = sum(seq_lens)
+        torch.manual_seed(0)
+        hidden_full = torch.randn(
+            total_tokens, 1, gdn_cp.config.hidden_size, device="cuda", dtype=torch.bfloat16
+        )
+        torch.distributed.broadcast(hidden_full, src=0)
+
+        reference_input = hidden_full.detach().clone().requires_grad_(True)
+        reference_output, _ = gdn_reference(
+            reference_input, None, packed_seq_params=packed_seq_params
+        )
+        reference_output.float().square().sum().backward()
+
+        local_len = total_tokens // cp_group.size()
+        local_slice = slice(cp_rank * local_len, (cp_rank + 1) * local_len)
+        local_input = hidden_full[local_slice].detach().clone().requires_grad_(True)
+        kwargs = {}
+        if packed_seq_params is not None:
+            seq_idx = torch.repeat_interleave(
+                torch.arange(len(seq_lens), dtype=torch.int32, device="cuda"),
+                torch.tensor(seq_lens, device="cuda"),
+            ).unsqueeze(0)
+            kwargs["packed_sequence_cp_metadata"] = build_packed_sequence_cp_metadata(
+                seq_idx, cp_rank=cp_rank, cp_size=cp_group.size()
+            )
+        local_output, _ = gdn_cp(local_input, None, packed_seq_params=packed_seq_params, **kwargs)
+        local_output.float().square().sum().backward()
+
+        torch.testing.assert_close(
+            local_output, reference_output[local_slice], atol=2e-2, rtol=2e-2
+        )
+        torch.testing.assert_close(
+            local_input.grad, reference_input.grad[local_slice], atol=5e-2, rtol=5e-2
+        )
+        reference_parameters = dict(gdn_reference.named_parameters())
+        for name, parameter in gdn_cp.named_parameters():
+            local_grad = (
+                torch.zeros_like(parameter) if parameter.grad is None else parameter.grad.clone()
+            )
+            torch.distributed.all_reduce(local_grad, group=cp_group)
+            reference_grad = reference_parameters[name].grad
+            assert reference_grad is not None, f"reference has no gradient for {name}"
+            torch.testing.assert_close(
+                local_grad,
+                reference_grad,
+                atol=1e-1,
+                rtol=5e-2,
+                msg=lambda msg, param_name=name: f"grad mismatch for {param_name!r}: {msg}",
+            )
+
+
+@pytest.mark.skipif(not HAVE_FUSED_PRE_GDR, reason="causal-conv1d fused backward is not installed.")
+class TestFusedPreGatedDeltaRuleChunkwiseCP:
+    """Fused and unfused pre-GDR agree under chunkwise CP=2 (ported from dev #5638)."""
+
+    pytestmark = _requires_cp2
+
+    @pytest.fixture(scope='function', autouse=True)
+    def setup_method(self):
+        Utils.initialize_model_parallel(
+            tensor_model_parallel_size=1, pipeline_model_parallel_size=1, context_parallel_size=2
+        )
+        model_parallel_cuda_manual_seed(123)
+        yield
+        torch.cuda.synchronize()
+        Utils.destroy_model_parallel()
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _build_pair(conv_kernel_dim: int = 4):
+        cp_group = parallel_state.get_context_parallel_group()
+        unfused = _build_gdn(
+            cp_group, gdn_pre_gated_delta_rule_fusion=False, linear_conv_kernel_dim=conv_kernel_dim
+        )
+        fused = _build_gdn(
+            cp_group, gdn_pre_gated_delta_rule_fusion=True, linear_conv_kernel_dim=conv_kernel_dim
+        )
+        fused.load_state_dict(unfused.state_dict())
+        return unfused, fused
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _make_hidden_states(gdn, *, seq_len_global: int):
+        cp_size = parallel_state.get_context_parallel_world_size()
+        assert seq_len_global % cp_size == 0
+        cp_rank = parallel_state.get_context_parallel_rank()
+        hidden_states = torch.randn(
+            (seq_len_global // cp_size, 1, gdn.config.hidden_size),
+            device=torch.cuda.current_device(),
+            dtype=torch.bfloat16,
+        )
+        return hidden_states + cp_rank
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _run_forward(gdn, hidden_states, packed_seq_params=None):
+        with torch.no_grad():
+            output, bias = gdn(hidden_states, None, packed_seq_params=packed_seq_params)
+        torch.distributed.barrier()
+        return output, bias
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _run_backward(gdn, hidden_states, grad_output, packed_seq_params=None):
+        gdn.zero_grad(set_to_none=True)
+        hidden_states = hidden_states.detach().clone().requires_grad_(True)
+        output, _ = gdn(hidden_states, None, packed_seq_params=packed_seq_params)
+        (output.float() * grad_output).sum().backward()
+        torch.distributed.barrier()
+        param_grads = {
+            name: param.grad.detach().clone()
+            for name, param in gdn.named_parameters()
+            if param.grad is not None
+        }
+        return output.detach(), hidden_states.grad.detach().clone(), param_grads
+
+    def _assert_backward_match(self, packed_seq_params, seq_len_global, param_grad_atol, label):
+        unfused_gdn, fused_gdn = self._build_pair()
+        hidden_states = self._make_hidden_states(unfused_gdn, seq_len_global=seq_len_global)
+        grad_output = torch.randn(
+            hidden_states.shape, device=torch.cuda.current_device(), dtype=torch.float32
+        )
+        unfused_output, unfused_dinput, unfused_grads = self._run_backward(
+            unfused_gdn, hidden_states, grad_output, packed_seq_params=packed_seq_params
+        )
+        fused_output, fused_dinput, fused_grads = self._run_backward(
+            fused_gdn, hidden_states, grad_output, packed_seq_params=packed_seq_params
+        )
+
+        rank = torch.distributed.get_rank()
+        torch.testing.assert_close(
+            fused_output,
+            unfused_output,
+            atol=3e-3,
+            rtol=3e-3,
+            msg=lambda msg: f"{label} fused backward output mismatch ({rank=}): {msg}",
+        )
+        torch.testing.assert_close(
+            fused_dinput,
+            unfused_dinput,
+            atol=5e-2,
+            rtol=5e-2,
+            msg=lambda msg: f"{label} fused input grad mismatch ({rank=}): {msg}",
+        )
+        assert fused_grads.keys() == unfused_grads.keys()
+        for name in unfused_grads:
+            torch.testing.assert_close(
+                fused_grads[name],
+                unfused_grads[name],
+                atol=param_grad_atol,
+                rtol=5e-2,
+                msg=lambda msg, param_name=name: (
+                    f"{label} fused grad mismatch for {param_name!r} ({rank=}): {msg}"
+                ),
+            )
+
+    def test_fused_and_unfused_forward_chunkwise_cp_match(self):
+        unfused_gdn, fused_gdn = self._build_pair()
+        hidden_states = self._make_hidden_states(unfused_gdn, seq_len_global=64)
+
+        unfused_output, unfused_bias = self._run_forward(unfused_gdn, hidden_states)
+        fused_output, fused_bias = self._run_forward(fused_gdn, hidden_states)
+
+        rank = torch.distributed.get_rank()
+        torch.testing.assert_close(
+            fused_output,
+            unfused_output,
+            atol=3e-3,
+            rtol=3e-3,
+            msg=lambda msg: f"chunkwise CP fused forward mismatch ({rank=}): {msg}",
+        )
+        assert fused_bias == unfused_bias
+
+    @pytest.mark.flaky_in_dev
+    def test_fused_and_unfused_backward_chunkwise_cp_match(self):
+        self._assert_backward_match(None, 64, 5e-2, "chunkwise CP")
+
+    def test_fused_chunkwise_cp_rejects_short_local_chunks(self):
+        _, fused_gdn = self._build_pair(conv_kernel_dim=4)
+        hidden_states = self._make_hidden_states(fused_gdn, seq_len_global=4)
+
+        with pytest.raises((AssertionError, ValueError), match="local.*chunk|conv_kernel_dim"):
+            fused_gdn(hidden_states, None)
+
+    def test_fused_and_unfused_packed_forward_chunkwise_cp_match(self):
+        unfused_gdn, fused_gdn = self._build_pair()
+        packed_seq_params = _make_packed_seq_params([96, 32])
+        hidden_states = self._make_hidden_states(unfused_gdn, seq_len_global=128)
+
+        unfused_output, unfused_bias = self._run_forward(
+            unfused_gdn, hidden_states, packed_seq_params=packed_seq_params
+        )
+        fused_output, fused_bias = self._run_forward(
+            fused_gdn, hidden_states, packed_seq_params=packed_seq_params
+        )
+
+        rank = torch.distributed.get_rank()
+        torch.testing.assert_close(
+            fused_output,
+            unfused_output,
+            atol=3e-3,
+            rtol=3e-3,
+            msg=lambda msg: f"packed chunkwise CP fused forward mismatch ({rank=}): {msg}",
+        )
+        assert fused_bias == unfused_bias
+
+    @pytest.mark.flaky_in_dev
+    def test_fused_and_unfused_packed_backward_chunkwise_cp_match(self):
+        # Packed chunkwise CP compares two bf16 backward implementations that differ in
+        # their causal-conv boundary path. A few parameter-gradient elements can land just
+        # above the dense-path tolerance while outputs and input gradients match tightly.
+        self._assert_backward_match(_make_packed_seq_params([96, 32]), 128, 1e-1, "packed CP")
+
+    def test_fused_and_unfused_packed_partial_boundary_chunkwise_cp_match(self):
+        self._assert_backward_match(
+            _make_packed_seq_params([4, 8]), 12, 1e-1, "partial-boundary packed CP"
+        )

+def _offsets_from_lengths(lengths):
+    offsets = [0]
+    for length in lengths:
+        offsets.append(offsets[-1] + length)
+    return offsets
+
+
+def _cp_context_for_rank(lengths, world_size, rank):
+    offsets = _offsets_from_lengths(lengths)
+    total = offsets[-1]
+    part = total // world_size
+    rank_start = part * rank
+    rank_end = rank_start + part
+
+    start_seq_idx = bisect.bisect_right(offsets[1:], rank_start)
+    end_seq_idx = bisect.bisect_left(offsets[:-1], rank_end)
+    local_offsets = [
+        min(max(offset, rank_start), rank_end) - rank_start
+        for offset in offsets[start_seq_idx : end_seq_idx + 1]
+    ]
+    local_offsets = [
+        offset
+        for idx, offset in enumerate(local_offsets)
+        if idx == 0 or offset != local_offsets[idx - 1]
+    ]
+    return SimpleNamespace(
+        cu_seqlens_cpu=torch.tensor(local_offsets, dtype=torch.int32),
+        global_num_seqs=len(lengths),
+        global_cu_seqlens_cpu=torch.tensor(offsets, dtype=torch.long),
+        pre_num_ranks=rank - offsets[start_seq_idx] // part,
+        post_num_ranks=(offsets[end_seq_idx] - 1) // part - rank,
+    )
+

+def test_cutedsl_cp_wrapper_marshals_different_streams(monkeypatch):
+    from megatron.core.ssm.gated_delta_net.internal_gdn_backend.kernels.fused_gdr_cp_cute import (
+        backend as cp_backend,
+    )
+
+    calls = []
+
+    class FakeWrapper:
+        def launch_validated(self, value, *, _stream_handle):
+            calls.append(("launch", value, _stream_handle))
+            return value
+
+    class FakeEvent:
+        def record(self, stream):
+            calls.append(("record", stream.name))
+
+    class FakeStream:
+        def __init__(self, name, handle):
+            self.name = name
+            self.cuda_stream = handle
+
+        def wait_event(self, event):
+            calls.append(("wait", self.name, event))
+
+    class FakeStreamContext:
+        def __init__(self, stream):
+            self.stream = stream
+
+        def __enter__(self):
+            calls.append(("enter", self.stream.name))
+
+        def __exit__(self, *_args):
+            calls.append(("exit", self.stream.name))
+
+    owner = FakeStream("owner", 11)
+    caller = FakeStream("caller", 22)
+    # Construction binds owner=11 before the first launch can race in.
+    handles = iter([11, 11, 22])
+    monkeypatch.setattr(cp_backend, "_raw_stream", lambda _device: next(handles))
+    monkeypatch.setattr(cp_backend.torch.cuda, "current_stream", lambda _device: owner)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(cp_backend.torch.cuda, "ExternalStream", lambda handle, device: caller)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(cp_backend.torch.cuda, "Event", FakeEvent)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(cp_backend.torch.cuda, "stream", FakeStreamContext)
+    wrapper = cp_backend._SerializedWrapper(FakeWrapper(), torch.device("cuda", 0))
+    assert wrapper._owner_handle == 11
+
+    assert wrapper.launch_validated(1) == 1
+    assert wrapper.launch_validated(2) == 2
+
+    assert calls[0] == ("launch", 1, 11)
+    assert calls[1][0:2] == ("record", "caller")
+    assert calls[2][0:2] == ("wait", "owner")
+    assert calls[3] == ("enter", "owner")
+    assert calls[4] == ("launch", 2, 11)
+    assert calls[5] == ("exit", "owner")
+    assert calls[6][0:2] == ("record", "owner")
+    assert calls[7][0:2] == ("wait", "caller")

+def _context(local_offsets=(0, _T), global_offsets=(0, _WORLD * _T), pre=1, post=2):
+    """A CP context as `prepare_cp_context_metadata` leaves it, for rank 1 of 4.
+
+    The defaults are one global sequence spanning the whole group; the packed
+    variants used below put a boundary inside rank 1's window.
+    """
+    return SimpleNamespace(
+        group=object(),
+        cu_seqlens_cpu=torch.tensor(local_offsets, dtype=torch.int32),
+        global_num_seqs=len(global_offsets) - 1,
+        global_cu_seqlens_cpu=torch.tensor(global_offsets, dtype=torch.long),
+        pre_num_ranks=pre,
+        post_num_ranks=post,
+    )

+def _gate(gate, H=_H):
+    if gate == "g":
+        return torch.empty((1, _T, H), dtype=torch.float32)
+    if gate == "gk":
+        return torch.empty((1, _T, H, _K), dtype=torch.float32)
+    return None
+
+
+def _operands(direction, gate, H=_H):
+    base = torch.empty((1, _T, H, _K), dtype=torch.bfloat16)
+    gates = {name: _gate(name, H) if gate == name else None for name in ("g", "gk")}
+    if direction == "forward":
+        return {
+            "k": base,
+            "w": torch.empty_like(base),
+            "u": torch.empty_like(base),
+            **gates,
+            "bg": None,
+            "v": None,
+        }
+    return {
+        "q": base,
+        "k": torch.empty_like(base),
+        "w": torch.empty_like(base),
+        "do": torch.empty_like(base),
+        "dv": torch.empty_like(base),
+        **gates,
+        "bg": None,
+        "dht": None,
+    }
+
+
+def _is_supported(direction, operands, context):
+    predicate = cp_backend._is_supported if direction == "forward" else cp_backend._is_supported_bwd
+    return predicate(**operands, chunk_size=64, cu_seqlens=context.cu_seqlens_cpu, context=context)

+
+def _reason(direction, reason):

+"""GB200 end-to-end correctness and performance coverage for internal GDR."""
+
+import math
+import os
+from statistics import median
+
+import pytest
+import torch
+import torch.nn.functional as F
+
+pytestmark = pytest.mark.launch_on_gb200
+
+_BATCH_SIZE = 1
+_SEQUENCE_LENGTH = 8192
+_HEADS = 64
+_HEAD_DIM = 128
+_SAMPLES = 5
+# Ragged packing: sequence cuts that are neither 64-aligned nor on CP rank boundaries.
+_RAGGED_LOCAL_LENGTHS = (4000, 3240, 65, 1, 886)
+_RAGGED_GLOBAL_CUTS = (12345, 20000)
+
+
+def _ragged_cu_seqlens(total_tokens, device):
+    cuts = [c for c in _RAGGED_GLOBAL_CUTS if c < total_tokens]
+    return torch.tensor([0, *cuts, total_tokens], device=device, dtype=torch.int32)
+
+
+def _make_inputs(device, *, packed=False):
+    torch.manual_seed(1234)
+    shape = (
+        (1, _BATCH_SIZE * _SEQUENCE_LENGTH, _HEADS, _HEAD_DIM)
+        if packed
+        else (_BATCH_SIZE, _SEQUENCE_LENGTH, _HEADS, _HEAD_DIM)
+    )
+    gate_shape = shape[:-1]
+    q = (0.1 * torch.randn(shape, device=device, dtype=torch.bfloat16)).requires_grad_()
+    k = (0.1 * torch.randn(shape, device=device, dtype=torch.bfloat16)).requires_grad_()
+    v = (0.1 * torch.randn(shape, device=device, dtype=torch.bfloat16)).requires_grad_()
+    g = F.logsigmoid(torch.randn(gate_shape, device=device, dtype=torch.float32))
+    beta = torch.sigmoid(torch.randn(gate_shape, device=device, dtype=torch.float32))
+    inputs = (
+        q,
+        k,
+        v,
+        g.to(torch.bfloat16).requires_grad_(),
+        beta.to(torch.bfloat16).requires_grad_(),
+    )
+    return inputs, torch.randn(shape, device=device, dtype=torch.bfloat16)
+
+
+def _forward_backward(
+    implementation, inputs, grad_output, recompute_h=False, cp_context=None, cu_seqlens=None
+):
+    output, _ = implementation.chunk_gated_delta_rule(
+        q=inputs[0],
+        k=inputs[1],
+        v=inputs[2],
+        g=inputs[3],
+        beta=inputs[4],
+        scale=_HEAD_DIM**-0.5,
+        recompute_h=recompute_h,
+        cu_seqlens=cu_seqlens,
+        cp_context=cp_context,
+    )
+    gradients = torch.autograd.grad(output, inputs, grad_outputs=grad_output)
+    return output, gradients
+
+
+def _median_gpu_ms(implementation, inputs, grad_output, cp_context=None, cu_seqlens=None):
+    def run():
+        _forward_backward(
+            implementation, inputs, grad_output, cp_context=cp_context, cu_seqlens=cu_seqlens
+        )
+
+    for _ in range(2):
+        run()
+    torch.cuda.synchronize()
+
+    samples = []
+    for _ in range(_SAMPLES):
+        start = torch.cuda.Event(enable_timing=True)
+        end = torch.cuda.Event(enable_timing=True)
+        start.record()
+        run()
+        end.record()
+        end.synchronize()
+        samples.append(start.elapsed_time(end))
+    return median(samples)
+

+# --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
+# KDA: FLA's Triton kernels plus the in-tree CuTe DSL CP pre-processing in its per-key gate mode.
+# --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+_KDA_HEADS = 8  # the CuTe CP dispatcher needs a multiple of four value heads
+_KDA_LOWER_BOUND = -5.0
+# Rank-independent: a TP shard holds the same A_log / dt_bias on every CP rank.
+_KDA_PARAM_SEED = 4242
+_KDA_NAMES = ("out", "dq", "dk", "dv", "dg", "dbeta", "dA_log", "ddt_bias")
+# Relative-L2 limits against FLA's own CP path on the same operands. On GB300 (CP4 and CP8) the
+# output and dq are bit-identical and the other gradients sit at 3.7e-3..5.4e-3; the limits
+# leave headroom for bf16 accumulation-order noise.
+_KDA_REL_L2_LIMITS = {
+    "out": 1e-2,
+    "dq": 1e-2,
+    "dk": 2e-2,
+    "dv": 2e-2,
+    "dg": 5e-2,
+    "dbeta": 2e-2,
+    "dA_log": 5e-2,
+    "ddt_bias": 5e-2,
+}
+
+
+def _cutedsl_cp_device(cp_size):
+    """Skip unless this is a Blackwell CUDA-13 rank of a ``cp_size``-rank distributed run."""
+    if not torch.cuda.is_available():
+        pytest.skip("CUDA is required")
+    local_rank = int(os.environ.get("LOCAL_RANK", "0"))
+    torch.cuda.set_device(local_rank)
+    device = torch.device("cuda", local_rank)
+    if torch.cuda.get_device_capability(device)[0] != 10:
+        pytest.skip("the CuTe DSL CP kernels require a Blackwell data-center GPU (SM10x)")
+    if not torch.version.cuda or int(torch.version.cuda.split(".", 1)[0]) < 13:
+        pytest.skip("the CuTe DSL CP kernels require CUDA 13+")
+    pytest.importorskip("cutlass")
+    pytest.importorskip("cuda.bindings.driver")
+    pytest.importorskip("fla.ops.kda")
+    world_size = int(os.environ.get("WORLD_SIZE", "1"))
+    if world_size != cp_size:
+        pytest.skip(f"CP{cp_size} coverage requires exactly {cp_size} distributed ranks")
+    return device
+
+
+def _make_kda_inputs(device, *, head_dim, seed):
+    """Operands shaped like KimiDeltaAttention hands them to chunk_kda (B=1, [1, T, H, D])."""
+    gen = torch.Generator().manual_seed(seed)
+    param_gen = torch.Generator().manual_seed(_KDA_PARAM_SEED)
+    shape = (1, _SEQUENCE_LENGTH, _KDA_HEADS, head_dim)
+
+    def rnd(*size):
+        return torch.randn(*size, generator=gen).to(device)
+
+    # Megatron L2-normalises q/k before the kernel (use_qk_l2norm_in_kernel=False) and passes
+    # the raw gate logits; the kernel applies A_log / dt_bias (use_gate_in_kernel=True).
+    q = F.normalize(rnd(*shape), dim=-1).to(torch.bfloat16)
+    k = F.normalize(rnd(*shape), dim=-1).to(torch.bfloat16)
+    v = (0.1 * rnd(*shape)).to(torch.bfloat16)
+    g = rnd(*shape).to(torch.bfloat16)
+    beta = torch.sigmoid(rnd(*shape[:-1])).float()
+    A_log = torch.log(torch.empty(_KDA_HEADS).uniform_(1.0, 16.0, generator=param_gen)).to(device)
+    dt_min, dt_max = 1e-3, 1e-1
+    dt = torch.exp(
+        torch.rand(_KDA_HEADS * head_dim, generator=param_gen)
+        * (math.log(dt_max) - math.log(dt_min))
+        + math.log(dt_min)
+    ).clamp(min=1e-4)
+    # Inverse softplus, as KimiDeltaAttention._reset_dt_bias.
+    dt_bias = (dt + torch.log(-torch.expm1(-dt))).to(device)
+    inputs = tuple(t.requires_grad_() for t in (q, k, v, g, beta, A_log, dt_bias))
+    return inputs, rnd(*shape).to(torch.bfloat16)
+
+
+def _kda_forward_backward(chunk_kda, inputs, grad_output, *, cp_context):
+    q, k, v, g, beta, A_log, dt_bias = inputs
+    output, _ = chunk_kda(
+        q=q,
+        k=k,
+        v=v,
+        g=g,
+        beta=beta,
+        A_log=A_log,
+        dt_bias=dt_bias,
+        initial_state=None,
+        output_final_state=False,
+        use_qk_l2norm_in_kernel=False,
+        use_gate_in_kernel=True,
+        safe_gate=True,
+        lower_bound=_KDA_LOWER_BOUND,
+        cp_context=cp_context,
+    )
+    return output, torch.autograd.grad(output, inputs, grad_outputs=grad_output)
+
+
+def _relative_l2(actual, expected):
+    expected = expected.detach().float()
+    diff = torch.linalg.vector_norm(actual.detach().float() - expected)
+    denom = torch.linalg.vector_norm(expected)
+    return (diff / denom).item() if denom > 0 else diff.item()
+
+
+def _build_kda_cp_context(device, cp_size, *, ragged, request):
+    from fla.ops.cp import build_cp_context
+
+    from megatron.core import parallel_state
+    from megatron.core.ssm.gated_delta_net.internal_gdn_backend import prepare_cp_context_metadata
+    from tests.unit_tests.test_utilities import Utils
+
+    Utils.initialize_model_parallel(context_parallel_size=cp_size)
+    request.addfinalizer(Utils.destroy_model_parallel)
+    group = parallel_state.get_context_parallel_group()
+    global_tokens = _SEQUENCE_LENGTH * cp_size
+    if ragged:
+        cu_seqlens = _ragged_cu_seqlens(global_tokens, device)
+    else:
+        cu_seqlens = torch.tensor([0, global_tokens], device=device, dtype=torch.int32)
+    cp_context = build_cp_context(cu_seqlens=cu_seqlens, group=group, conv1d_kernel_size=4)
+    prepare_cp_context_metadata(
+        cp_context, global_num_sequences=cu_seqlens.numel() - 1, global_cu_seqlens=cu_seqlens
+    )
+    return cp_context, torch.distributed.get_rank(group=group)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("ragged", [False, True], ids=["aligned", "ragged"])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("cp_size", [2, 4], ids=["cp2", "cp4"])
+def test_internal_kda_cute_cp_preprocess_matches_fla(monkeypatch, cp_size, ragged, request):
+    """Strict ``cute`` mode at the Kimi head geometry (K == V == 128): the CuTe CP pre-processing
+    must launch in both directions, never fall back, and match FLA's own CP path on the output
+    and all seven gradients."""
+    device = _cutedsl_cp_device(cp_size)
+    from megatron.core.ssm.gated_delta_net.internal_gdn_backend import chunk_kda
+    from megatron.core.ssm.gated_delta_net.internal_gdn_backend.kernels import fused_gdr_cp_cute
+
+    cp_context, rank = _build_kda_cp_context(device, cp_size, ragged=ragged, request=request)
+    inputs, grad_output = _make_kda_inputs(device, head_dim=_HEAD_DIM, seed=1234 + rank)
+
+    monkeypatch.setenv("MCORE_GDN_INTERNAL_BACKEND", "fla")
+    monkeypatch.setenv("MCORE_GDN_CP_CUTEDSL", "0")
+    reference = _kda_forward_backward(chunk_kda, inputs, grad_output, cp_context=cp_context)
+
+    forward_before = fused_gdr_cp_cute.get_cutedsl_fused_launch_count()
+    backward_before = fused_gdr_cp_cute.get_cutedsl_fused_bwd_launch_count()
+    fused_gdr_cp_cute.reset_cutedsl_fallback_reasons()
+    monkeypatch.setenv("MCORE_GDN_INTERNAL_BACKEND", "cute")
+    monkeypatch.setenv("MCORE_GDN_CP_CUTEDSL", "1")
+    actual = _kda_forward_backward(chunk_kda, inputs, grad_output, cp_context=cp_context)
+    # One CuTe boundary launch per direction. Strict mode raises on a fallback; the empty
+    # fallback-reason map is the second witness that the dispatcher never declined.
+    assert fused_gdr_cp_cute.get_cutedsl_fused_launch_count() == forward_before + 1
+    assert fused_gdr_cp_cute.get_cutedsl_fused_bwd_launch_count() == backward_before + 1
+    assert fused_gdr_cp_cute.get_cutedsl_fallback_reasons() == {}
+
+    torch.testing.assert_close(actual[0], reference[0], atol=1e-2, rtol=1e-2)
+    for name, got, expected in zip(
+        _KDA_NAMES, (actual[0], *actual[1]), (reference[0], *reference[1])
+    ):
+        assert torch.isfinite(got).all(), f"{name} is not finite"
+        relative_l2 = _relative_l2(got, expected)
+        assert (
+            relative_l2 <= _KDA_REL_L2_LIMITS[name]
+        ), f"{name}: relative L2 {relative_l2:.3e} > {_KDA_REL_L2_LIMITS[name]:.1e} vs FLA"
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("cp_size", [2, 4], ids=["cp2", "cp4"])
+def test_internal_kda_head_dim_outside_cute_envelope_is_not_silent(monkeypatch, cp_size, request):
+    """Head dims other than 128 cannot pass as CuTe coverage: ``cute`` mode raises with the
+    dispatcher's reason, and ``auto`` mode records the fallback while matching FLA's output.
+
+    Only the output is compared: with 64-dim heads FLA's own CP backward is not run-to-run
+    reproducible on GB300 (fla-core 0.5.1 and 0.5.2 alike, two FLA runs differ by ~10 % relative
+    L2 on dk/dv/dg/dbeta while the output and dq are bit-identical), so gradient closeness says
+    nothing about the adapter here; the 128-dim tests above cover the gradients.
+    """
+    device = _cutedsl_cp_device(cp_size)
+    from megatron.core.ssm.gated_delta_net.internal_gdn_backend import chunk_kda
+    from megatron.core.ssm.gated_delta_net.internal_gdn_backend.kernels import fused_gdr_cp_cute
+
+    cp_context, rank = _build_kda_cp_context(device, cp_size, ragged=False, request=request)
+    inputs, grad_output = _make_kda_inputs(device, head_dim=64, seed=1234 + rank)
+
+    monkeypatch.setenv("MCORE_GDN_INTERNAL_BACKEND", "cute")
+    monkeypatch.setenv("MCORE_GDN_CP_CUTEDSL", "1")
+    with pytest.raises(RuntimeError, match=r"K=64,V=64 \(need K==V==128\)"):
+        _kda_forward_backward(chunk_kda, inputs, grad_output, cp_context=cp_context)
+
+    forward_before = fused_gdr_cp_cute.get_cutedsl_fused_launch_count()
+    fused_gdr_cp_cute.reset_cutedsl_fallback_reasons()
+    monkeypatch.setenv("MCORE_GDN_INTERNAL_BACKEND", "auto")

+    assert args == (fwd["cp_initial_state"],) and kwargs == {"context": cp_context}
+
+    _args, kwargs = _only_call(seen, "chunk_gla_fwd_o_gk")
+    assert (
+        kwargs["q"] is inputs["q"]
+        and kwargs["v"] is fwd["v_new"]
+        and kwargs["g"] is fwd["g_cumsum"]
+    )
+    assert kwargs["A"] is fwd["Aqk"] and kwargs["h"] is fwd["h"] and kwargs["scale"] == scale
+
+    saved = ctx.saved_tensors
+    assert len(saved) == 19
+    assert saved[0] is inputs["q"] and saved[1] is inputs["k"] and saved[2] is inputs["v"]
+    assert saved[4] is inputs["g"] and saved[5] is inputs["beta"]
+    assert saved[6] is gate["A_log"] and saved[7] is gate["dt_bias"]
+    assert saved[8] is fwd["Aqk"] and saved[9] is fwd["Akk"]
+    if disable_recompute:
+        assert saved[3] is fwd["g_cumsum"]
+        assert saved[10:16] == (fwd["w"], fwd["u"], fwd["qg"], fwd["kg"], fwd["v_new"], fwd["h"])
+    else:
+        # Same saved set as FLA: the gate cumsum and every recompute intermediate drop.
+        assert saved[3] is None
+        assert saved[10:16] == (None,) * 6
+    assert saved[16] is fwd["compressed_initial_state"]
+    assert saved[17] is cp_context.cu_seqlens and saved[18] is fwd["chunk_indices"]
+    assert ctx.scale == scale and ctx.safe_gate is True and ctx.lower_bound == -5.0
+    assert ctx.use_gate_in_kernel is True and ctx.disable_recompute is disable_recompute
+    assert ctx.cp_context is cp_context and ctx.strict is False
+
+    do = torch.empty(_SHAPE, dtype=torch.bfloat16)
+    backward = _unwrap(adapter.InternalChunkKDAFunction.backward)
+    grads = backward(ctx, do, None)
+
+    assert len(grads) == 16
+    dq, dk, dv, dg, dbeta, dA, dbias = grads[:7]
+    assert dq.dtype == inputs["q"].dtype and torch.all(dq == 1)
+    assert dk.dtype == inputs["k"].dtype and torch.all(dk == 2)
+    assert dv.dtype == inputs["v"].dtype and torch.all(dv == 3)
+    assert dg.dtype == inputs["g"].dtype and torch.all(dg == 4)
+    assert dbeta.dtype == inputs["beta"].dtype and torch.all(dbeta == 5)
+    assert dA is bwd["dA"] and dbias is bwd["dbias"]
+    assert all(entry is None for entry in grads[7:])
+
+    if disable_recompute:
+        assert "recompute_w_u_fwd" not in seen
+        assert len(seen["kda_gate_chunk_cumsum"]) == 1
+        assert len(seen["chunk_gated_delta_rule_fwd_h"]) == 1
+    else:
+        assert len(seen["kda_gate_chunk_cumsum"]) == 2
+        assert seen["kda_gate_chunk_cumsum"][1][1]["g"] is inputs["g"]
+        _args, kwargs = _only_call(seen, "recompute_w_u_fwd")
+        # q is passed so the backward materialises qg for the CP pre-process.
+        assert (
+            kwargs["q"] is inputs["q"] and kwargs["k"] is inputs["k"] and kwargs["v"] is inputs["v"]
+        )
+        assert kwargs["beta"] is inputs["beta"] and kwargs["A"] is fwd["Akk"]
+        assert kwargs["gk"] is fwd["g_cumsum"]
+        assert len(seen["chunk_gated_delta_rule_fwd_h"]) == 2
+        recomputed = seen["chunk_gated_delta_rule_fwd_h"][1][1]
+        assert recomputed["initial_state"] is fwd["expanded_initial_state"]
+        assert "cu_seqlens_cpu" not in recomputed
+    args, kwargs = _only_call(seen, "expand_h0")
+    assert args == (fwd["compressed_initial_state"],) and kwargs == {"context": cp_context}
+
+    _args, kwargs = _only_call(seen, "chunk_kda_bwd_dAv")
+    assert kwargs["q"] is inputs["q"] and kwargs["k"] is inputs["k"] and kwargs["v"] is fwd["v_new"]
+    assert kwargs["do"] is do and kwargs["A"] is fwd["Aqk"] and kwargs["scale"] == scale
+
+    # The backward CP pre-process sees qg (the gk-mode kernel never gates q itself),
+    # kg, w, the local dv term, and the fp32 log2 cumsum as gk.
+    args, kwargs = _only_call(seen, "_cp_backward_preprocess")
+    assert args == ()
+    assert set(kwargs) == {
+        "q",
+        "k",
+        "w",
+        "do",
+        "dv",

+    assert kwargs["do"] is do and kwargs["dv"] is bwd["dAv_dv"] and kwargs["gk"] is fwd["g_cumsum"]
+    assert kwargs["scale"] == scale and kwargs["cu_seqlens"] is cp_context.cu_seqlens
+    assert kwargs["dht"] is None and kwargs["initial_state"] is fwd["expanded_initial_state"]
+    assert kwargs["context"] is cp_context
+
+    _args, kwargs = _only_call(seen, "chunk_gated_delta_rule_bwd_dhu")
+    assert kwargs["q"] is fwd["qg"] and kwargs["k"] is fwd["kg"] and kwargs["w"] is fwd["w"]
+    assert kwargs["gk"] is fwd["g_cumsum"]
+    # The pre-process returns (dht, None): the local state is dropped, dht is consumed.
+    assert kwargs["h0"] is None and kwargs["dht"] is bwd["dht_out"]
+    assert kwargs["do"] is do and kwargs["dv"] is bwd["dAv_dv"] and kwargs["scale"] == scale
+
+    _args, kwargs = _only_call(seen, "chunk_kda_bwd_wy_dqkg_fused")
+    assert kwargs["q"] is inputs["q"] and kwargs["k"] is inputs["k"] and kwargs["v"] is inputs["v"]

+    assert (

+    )
+    assert kwargs["do"] is do and kwargs["dh"] is bwd["dh"] and kwargs["dv"] is bwd["dhu_dv"]
+

+    assert (
+        kwargs["q"] is inputs["q"] and kwargs["k"] is inputs["k"] and kwargs["g"] is fwd["g_cumsum"]
+    )
+    assert kwargs["dAqk"] is bwd["dAqk"] and kwargs["dAkk"] is bwd["dAkk"]

+
+    _args, kwargs = _only_call(seen, "kda_gate_bwd")
+    assert kwargs["g"] is inputs["g"] and kwargs["dyg"] is bwd["dg_cumsum"]

+"""Startup guards for full-iteration CUDA graphs with packed (THD) inputs.
+
+Full-iteration capture records ``get_batch`` too, so packed inputs are accepted only on the
+``--sft`` path under the static THD contract, at CP = 1 and PP = 1. Run with four ranks so the
+CP = 2 and PP = 2 cases pass the world-size checks and reach these guards.
+"""

+import os

+import pytest
+

+pytestmark = pytest.mark.skipif(
+    int(os.environ.get("WORLD_SIZE", "1")) % 4 != 0, reason="requires a multiple of four ranks"
+)
+
+
+def _args(monkeypatch, **overrides):
+    monkeypatch.setattr(sys, 'argv', ['test_full_iteration_thd_args.py'])
+    args = parse_args()
+    args.num_layers = 4
+    args.vocab_size = 256
+    args.hidden_size = 64
+    args.num_attention_heads = 4
+    args.max_position_embeddings = 128
+    args.seq_length = 128
+    args.micro_batch_size = 1
+    args.train_iters = 1
+    args.lr = 1e-4
+    args.tokenizer_type = 'NullTokenizer'
+    args.mock_data = True
+    args.cuda_graph_impl = 'full_iteration'
+    args.check_for_nan_in_loss_and_grad = False
+    for key, value in overrides.items():
+        setattr(args, key, value)
+    return args
+
+
+STATIC_THD = dict(
+    sft=True,
+    pad_packed_seq_alignment='max',
+    max_seqlen_per_dp_cp_rank=128,
+    thd_max_packed_sequences=8,
+)
+
+

+# Copyright (c) 2026 NVIDIA CORPORATION & AFFILIATES. All rights reserved.
+
+"""Expert-parallel non-emerging (Adam) param groups on the layer-wise + DistOpt path.
+
+In layer-wise mode the emerging optimizer (Muon) owns the matrix parameters through
+``LayerWiseDistributedOptimizer``, and everything else is handed to a sibling
+``DistributedOptimizer``. That sibling used to be dense-only, so a parameter that is both
+expert-parallel and non-Muon had nowhere to go. It is not a hypothetical combination: a hashed
+n-gram / PLE memory is EP-sharded (``allreduce=False``) *and* tagged
+``is_embedding_or_output_parameter``, so it is expert-parallel and Adam-managed at once.
+
+Two things are tested, and the second matters as much as the first:
+
+1. such a model builds a three-way chain and the expert sibling shards over the expert-DP group;
+2. a Muon model *without* expert-parallel non-Muon params builds exactly the chain it built
+   before -- the containment property that keeps this change off every other training route.
+"""
+
+import os
+
+import pytest
+import torch
+import torch.nn as nn
+import torch.nn.functional as F
+from packaging.version import Version
+
+from megatron.core import parallel_state
+from megatron.core.distributed import DistributedDataParallelConfig
+from megatron.core.optimizer import ChainedOptimizer, OptimizerConfig, get_megatron_optimizer
+from megatron.core.optimizer.layer_wise_optimizer import LayerWiseDistributedOptimizer
+from megatron.core.process_groups_config import ProcessGroupCollection
+from megatron.core.transformer import TransformerConfig
+from megatron.core.utils import get_pg_size
+from tests.unit_tests.test_utilities import Utils
+
+pytestmark = pytest.mark.skipif(
+    Version(os.getenv('NVIDIA_PYTORCH_VERSION', "24.01")) <= Version("25.05"),
+    reason="Skip layer-wise optimizer for LTS test",
+)
+
+
+class _MatrixOnlyModel(nn.Module):
+    """Plain 2-D weights: every weight is Muon-eligible, biases go to the scalar optimizer."""
+
+    def __init__(self, input_size=32, hidden_size=16, output_size=8):
+        super().__init__()
+        self.fc1 = nn.Linear(input_size, hidden_size)
+        self.fc2 = nn.Linear(hidden_size, output_size)
+
+    def forward(self, x):
+        return self.fc2(F.relu(self.fc1(x)))
+
+
+class _ExpertTableModel(_MatrixOnlyModel):
+    """Adds an EP-sharded, embedding-tagged table -- expert-parallel *and* Adam-managed.
+
+    The two tags are what a real hashed-memory module sets (see
+    ``megatron/core/models/engram/distributed_embedding.py``): ``allreduce=False`` makes the
+    parameter expert-parallel, and ``is_embedding_or_output_parameter=True`` keeps it out of
+    Newton-Schulz orthogonalization.
+    """
+
+    def __init__(self, table_rows=12, table_dim=8, **kwargs):
+        super().__init__(**kwargs)
+        self.table = nn.Parameter(torch.empty(table_rows, table_dim))
+        nn.init.normal_(self.table, std=0.02)
+        self.table.allreduce = False
+        self.table.is_embedding_or_output_parameter = True
+
+    def forward(self, x):
+        return super().forward(x) + self.table.sum()
+
+
+def _build_optimizer(model_class):
+    """Wrap ``model_class`` in DDP the way the layer-wise path requires, and build the optimizer."""
+    from megatron.training.training import wrap_model_chunks_with_ddp
+
+    model = model_class().bfloat16().cuda()
+    model.requires_grad_(True)
+
+    transformer_config = TransformerConfig(num_attention_heads=1, num_layers=1)
+    # use_layer_wise_distributed_optimizer=True makes wrap_model_chunks_with_ddp force
+    # ddp_config.use_distributed_optimizer=True, which is what selects the split path.
+    model = wrap_model_chunks_with_ddp(
+        [model],
+        transformer_config,
+        DistributedDataParallelConfig(),
+        use_layer_wise_distributed_optimizer=True,
+    )[0]
+    model.broadcast_params()
+
+    optimizer_config = OptimizerConfig(
+        optimizer='muon',
+        lr=0.01,
+        weight_decay=0.01,
+        bf16=True,
+        use_distributed_optimizer=False,
+        clip_grad=1.0,
+        muon_tp_mode="duplicated",
+        use_layer_wise_distributed_optimizer=True,
+    )
+
+    pg_collection = ProcessGroupCollection.use_mpu_process_groups()
+    pg_collection.dp_cp = parallel_state.get_data_parallel_group(with_context_parallel=True)
+    pg_collection.expt_dp = parallel_state.get_expert_data_parallel_group()
+
+    optimizer = get_megatron_optimizer(
+        optimizer_config, [model], pg_collection=pg_collection, use_gloo_process_groups=False
+    )
+    return model, optimizer
+
+
+class TestLayerWiseExpertDistOpt:
+    """Expert-parallel Adam groups get their own DistOpt instance on the layer-wise path."""
+
+    @pytest.fixture(autouse=True)
+    def setup_and_teardown(self):
+        Utils.initialize_model_parallel(expert_model_parallel_size=2)
+        yield
+        Utils.destroy_model_parallel()
+
+    def test_expert_parallel_adam_group_gets_its_own_distopt(self):
+        """An EP-sharded Adam table builds a third chain member on the expert-DP group.
+
+        Before the fix this raised "Non-emerging expert-parallel param groups are not yet
+        supported"; there was nowhere to put the table.
+        """
+        _, optimizer = _build_optimizer(_ExpertTableModel)
+
+        assert isinstance(optimizer, ChainedOptimizer)
+        children = optimizer.chained_optimizers
+        assert len(children) == 3, (
+            "expected LayerWise + dense DistOpt + expert DistOpt, got "
+            f"{[type(c).__name__ for c in children]}"
+        )
+        assert isinstance(children[0], LayerWiseDistributedOptimizer)
+
+        # The two siblings must shard over different data-parallel groups: the dense one over
+        # DP, the expert one over expert-DP. With EP=2 those have different sizes, which is the
+        # cheapest way to tell them apart without reaching into private state.
+        dense, expert = children[1], children[2]
+        dp_size = get_pg_size(parallel_state.get_data_parallel_group(with_context_parallel=True))
+        expt_dp_size = get_pg_size(parallel_state.get_expert_data_parallel_group())
+        assert get_pg_size(dense.data_parallel_group) == dp_size
+        assert get_pg_size(expert.data_parallel_group) == expt_dp_size
+
+    def test_expert_table_state_is_sharded_over_expert_dp(self):
+        """The point of the exercise: the table's optimizer state is split, not replicated."""
+        model, optimizer = _build_optimizer(_ExpertTableModel)
+
+        expt_dp_size = get_pg_size(parallel_state.get_expert_data_parallel_group())
+        if expt_dp_size == 1:
+            pytest.skip("expert-DP size 1 shards nothing; run with EP < world size")
+
+        expert = optimizer.chained_optimizers[2]
+        # Sum of this rank's shard across the param groups the expert sibling owns.
+        owned = sum(p.numel() for group in expert.optimizer.param_groups for p in group['params'])
+        table_numel = model.module.table.numel()
+        assert owned < table_numel, (
+            f"expert sibling holds {owned} elements of a {table_numel}-element table; "
+            "expected a shard, so the state is still replicated"
+        )
+
+    def test_step_runs(self):
+        """A full step must work end to end, not just construction."""
+        model, optimizer = _build_optimizer(_ExpertTableModel)
+        optimizer.zero_grad()
+        out = model(torch.randn(4, 32, dtype=torch.bfloat16, device='cuda'))
+        out.sum().backward()
+        model.finish_grad_sync()
+        _, grad_norm, _ = optimizer.step()
+        assert grad_norm is None or torch.isfinite(torch.as_tensor(grad_norm))
+
+
+class TestLayerWiseExpertDistOptContainment:
+    """A Muon model with no expert-parallel Adam params must be unaffected by the change."""
+
+    @pytest.fixture(autouse=True)
+    def setup_and_teardown(self):
+        Utils.initialize_model_parallel(expert_model_parallel_size=2)
+        yield
+        Utils.destroy_model_parallel()
+
+    def test_no_expert_group_builds_the_original_two_member_chain(self):
+        """Without an expert-parallel non-Muon param the chain is LayerWise + one dense DistOpt.
+
+        This is the regression guard for the containment property: the expert partition must
+        stay empty and contribute no optimizer, exactly as before the change.
+        """
+        _, optimizer = _build_optimizer(_MatrixOnlyModel)
+
+        assert isinstance(optimizer, ChainedOptimizer)
+        children = optimizer.chained_optimizers
+        assert len(children) == 2, (
+            "a model with no expert-parallel non-Muon params must build the same two-member "
+            f"chain it built before the change, got {[type(c).__name__ for c in children]}"
+        )
